content_tree.supporting_text: Northwind turns declarative job graphs into hardened, observable infrastructure that heals itself before anyone is woken up.

content_tree.primary_claim: Everything that used to be glue code

items.title: Declarative graphs
items.body: Describe dependencies once; Northwind derives retries, backfills and back-pressure from the same source of truth.

items.title: Built-in lineage
items.body: Every run records the inputs it read and the outputs it wrote, so impact analysis is a query instead of an archaeology project.

items.title: Self-healing retries
items.body: Transient failures are isolated and retried with exponential backoff while the rest of the graph keeps making progress.

content_tree.supporting_text: Teams migrate to Northwind in an afternoon and rarely look back. The platform keeps your existing orchestration, then adds the guarantees it never had.

items.title: Do I have to rewrite my pipelines?
items.body: No. Northwind reads your existing definitions and layers scheduling, retries and lineage on top.

items.title: Where do my runs execute?
items.body: On our managed runners by default, or in your own VPC with the enterprise plan.

items.title: How is lineage stored?
items.body: As an append-only event log scoped to your workspace, exportable at any time.

items.title: What happens when a run fails?
items.body: The failure is quarantined, retried with backoff, and the surrounding graph continues unless you opt into a hard dependency.
